# ⚔️ **TrimBlades v1.0.0 Texture Pack** 🎨
## 🎥 Blade Textures Showcase ![Blade Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01bd9b6a1b24d41b70943cb74de063b509b9a005_0.webp) Experience the stunning custom textures and visual effects of all 19 legendary blades + the Cooldown Dial in action!
---
Spoiler ## ⚔️ **The Arsenal** — 19 Legendary Blades + Bonus Items Each blade is a masterpiece with unique abilities, custom particles, and devastating power. Activate with **Right Click** or your configured trigger key! ### 🛡️ Ward Blade — *The Warden Beam* Shoot a powerful **Warden-style sonic boom** that bypasses armor entirely. Deals massive damage at range with devastating sonic particles. ### 🌊 Coast Blade — *The Riptide Rush* Launch yourself forward like a **Riptide trident**. Works in rain or water for high-speed mobility — perfect for aggressive gap-closing or quick escapes. ### 🚀 Raiser Blade — *The Dash Strike* Perform a **lightning-fast dash** in the direction you're looking, damaging all enemies in your path with electrifying particle trails. ### 🧭 Wayfinder Blade — *The Player Compass* Points to the **closest player** near you via action bar display. Track targets across 500 blocks — or set the range to infinite for relentless pursuit. ### 👥 Host Blade — *The Phantom Copy* Hit a player to **copy their trim ability** for yourself. Steal their power and use it against them — the ultimate counter-pick. ### 🏰 Sentry Blade — *The Pillager Rampage* Summon **3 Pillager allies** that follow you and automatically attack non-trusted players. They teleport with you and speed up when you run. ### 👻 Vex Blade — *The Phase Strike* Summon **3 Vex allies** that phase through blocks to hunt down your enemies. Highly aggressive and nearly impossible to escape. ### 🌿 Wild Blade — *The Savage Roots* Summon **thorny vines** from the ground that trap and damage enemies in an 8-block radius. Grants Regeneration I while holding. ### 🏜️ Dune Blade — *The Sandstorm* Create a realistic **sandstorm tornado** that pulls entities in, spins them around, and launches them out. Blinds everything caught inside. ### 🔨 Shaper Blade — *The Forge Armor* Temporarily enhance your equipment with **Resistance II, Absorption II, and Fire Resistance**. Passively reflects 25% of melee damage back at attackers. ### 🤫 Silence Blade — *The Deadly Invis* Grants **complete invisibility** — including armor and held items. Silent footsteps, reduced mob detection, and a slight speed boost for true stealth. ### 🌊 Tide Blade — *The Tsunami Wave* Unleash a massive **wall of real water blocks** that pushes enemies back with immense force. Deals 3 hearts of damage with heavy knockback. ### 🐗 Snout Blade — *The Bastion's Fury* Summon a massive temporary **Nether fortress arena** of Blackstone pillars. You gain Strength III inside while enemies suffer Weakness II and take beam damage. ### 🦴 Rib Blade — *The Marrow Shield* A reactive defense blade — taking damage triggers **Resistance II** and a passive **+30% damage boost**. The more you're hit, the harder you hit back. ### 👁️ Eye Blade — *The Time Rewind* **Rewind your position** to where you were ~20 seconds ago. Escape traps, dodge attacks, or confuse enemies with temporal trickery. ### 🗼 Spire Blade — *The Void Collapse* Summon a **gravitational singularity** that pulls enemies in with Slowness V, crushes them with 12 hearts of damage, then launches them skyward for lethal fall damage. ### 💧 Flow Blade — *The Wind Ride* Spawn and mount a **rideable Wind Charge** vehicle with full WASD flight control. Ascend with Space, descend with Shift — 90 seconds of aerial dominance. ### ⚡ Bolt Blade — *The Lightning Dash* Non-trusted players **glow** in your vision. Right-click while looking at one to **teleport to them** with a devastating lightning strike on arrival. ### 🥚 Dragon Egg Blade — *The SkyFall* Launch into the sky and crash down with an **explosive impact**. The higher you fall, the more devastating the explosion — works with Elytra for aerial combat. --- ### 🎁 Bonus: Cooldown Dial A custom-textured clock item that **reduces all trim cooldowns by 50%** when held in your offhand or inventory. Stack the advantage!
